author: MandrakeCRM

sections.description:
🚀 MandrakeCRM is the all-in-one marketing platform built exclusively for WooCommerce stores.

CRM, pre-configured automations, ultra-personalized campaigns, and analytics. Everything connected. Ready to activate. Charges per order, not per contact — unlimited contacts at no extra cost.

😱 The Problem

What’s holding back your WooCommerce store’s sales?

  • Disconnected data — Your email tool says one number, WooCommerce says another. None of them connect your marketing efforts with your sales results.
  • Customers who don’t come back — Acquiring a new customer costs 5x more than retaining an existing one. Without personalized follow-up, only 15% return.
  • Difficult and expensive tools — Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign… Between the complexity of setup and the monthly cost, they end up abandoned.
  • Your list grows and so does your bill — Most charge per contact. Your base grows, your bill rises, but your sales don’t. You pay more to store contacts, not to sell more.

✅ The Solution

With other tools:
* Emails, analytics, and sales in separate tools. Data that never connects.
* Weeks of setup. You need an expert or an agency.
* Per-contact pricing. The more customers, the more you pay — whether you sell or not.

With MandrakeCRM:
* CRM, automations, campaigns, and analytics in a single platform. Data connected end to end.
* Pre-configured by experts. Activate automations with one click. Your marketing works 24/7 from day one.
* Per-order pricing. You only pay more when you sell more. Unlimited contacts.

⚡ Key Features

📊 CRM — Smart, personalized segmentation
Automatically classifies your customers by behavior and lifecycle. Or create custom filters tailored to your needs. 1 in 4 buyers becomes a repeat customer with behavior-based personalization.

🤖 Automations — Pre-configured by experts
Welcome, abandoned carts, repurchase, and more. Activate them with one click. Our customers recover 10-15% of abandoned carts within the first 30 days.

💌 Campaigns — Ultra-personalized to precise segments
Messages to specific segments. Templates for key dates in your store. 3.5x higher conversion than campaigns without segmentation.

📈 Analytics — Marketing and sales connected in real time
Campaigns, conversion, and repurchase in a single view. The real impact of every action, without jumping between tools.

🎁 Extra Resources

  • Smart Dashboard — Store and marketing metrics in a single panel.
  • Lead Capture Widget — Popups and widgets ready to capture leads.
  • Weekly Digest — Weekly marketing metrics delivered to your inbox.
  • Email Deliverability — Sent from your own domain. Inbox, not spam.
  • Customer Portal — Your customers manage their preferences autonomously.
  • Branding Customization — Colors, logos, and visual identity in minutes.
  • Quick Integration — Connect WooCommerce in 5 minutes with one click.
  • Transparent Privacy — Privacy page generated automatically.

🔧 How It Works

Step 1: Connect your store
Install the WooCommerce plugin and sync customers, orders, and products in minutes. No technical setup needed.

Step 2: Activate automations
Choose from automations pre-configured by experts. Welcome, abandoned carts, repurchase, and more. One click.

Step 3: Start selling more
Your campaigns and automations work 24/7. You focus on your business, MandrakeCRM handles the marketing.

👤 Who Is MandrakeCRM For

WooCommerce store owners
Your marketing and sales data is scattered across 3 different tools. With MandrakeCRM, everything centralized in one place for better decisions.

Marketing managers
Your team wastes hours jumping between platforms. One single tool with everything integrated.

Small and medium businesses
You need marketing results without the complexity (or the cost) of building a dedicated team.

💜 Why Choose MandrakeCRM

“No weeks of setup” — Pre-configured automations ready to activate. Start recovering revenue from day 1.

“Everything connected” — CRM, emails, automations, and analytics integrated in a single platform.

“No per-contact fees” — Unlike Klaviyo or Mailchimp, you don’t pay more as your list grows. Charges per order, not per contact.

“Built for WooCommerce, not adapted” — Native integration, not a generic tool with plugins.

7-day free trial — See results before you pay. No credit card required.

💬 Testimonials

“Before, we didn’t have time for marketing. With MandrakeCRM, everything went on autopilot. Our email conversion increased 3x and customer retention grew 25% in four months.”
— Lisandra Nanya, Founder, semi-jewelry e-commerce, Sorocaba/SP, Brazil

“We used Mailchimp for emails, Google Analytics for data, and a spreadsheet for CRM. With MandrakeCRM we eliminated all of that. Now we have everything in one platform and the team saves hours every week.”
— Carolina Domínguez, Marketing Manager, fashion e-commerce, Buenos Aires, Argentina

“With Klaviyo we paid for every new contact. Our list grew to 8,000 customers and the bill skyrocketed. With MandrakeCRM we pay per order, not per contact. Our list keeps growing at no extra cost.”
— Ricardo Meneses, Co-founder, supplements e-commerce, Santiago, Chile

👉 Start Selling More — No marketing expertise needed. Free for 7 days. No credit card required.

Privacy Policy

MandrakeCRM connects to external services to provide its functionality. For complete privacy details, visit: https://www.mandrakecrm.com/en/privacy-policy

External Services

This plugin connects to MandrakeCRM external services for CRM, email marketing, and abandoned cart recovery functionality.

MandrakeCRM API

Provider: MandrakeCRM
Endpoint: https://mandrakecrm.supabase.co/functions/v1
Terms of Service: https://www.mandrakecrm.com/en/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.mandrakecrm.com/en/privacy-policy

Data transmitted:
– License verification: token, plugin/WordPress/WooCommerce/PHP versions, site URL
– Transactional emails: customer email, order details, billing/shipping addresses
– Abandoned carts: cart contents, customer email, recovery URL

MandrakeCRM CDN

URL: https://cdn.mandrakecrm.io
Purpose: Load lead capture widgets
Data transmitted: None (static assets only)

Important Notes

  • No data is transmitted until you configure the plugin with your token
  • All transmission occurs over HTTPS
  • You can disable specific features in settings
  • By using this plugin, you agree to MandrakeCRM’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > MandrakeCRM to configure the plugin
  4. Create your account at app.mandrakecrm.io/en/signup if you don’t have one
  5. Get your token at Settings → Store and enter it in the plugin
  6. Enable the features you want to use
  7. Activate pre-configured automations in MandrakeCRM and start selling more
sections.faq:
Do I need a MandrakeCRM account?

Yes. Visit app.mandrakecrm.io/en/signup for a 7-day free trial — no credit card required.

How much does MandrakeCRM cost?

We charge per orders received, not per contacts. Your list grows at no extra cost. Recalculated every cycle based on the last 3 months. Slow season? You pay less. Find your monthly cost on our pricing page: www.mandrakecrm.com/en/pricing

Will I be charged after the 7-day trial?

No. Enjoy all features for 7 days with no credit card. No hidden charges.

How is it different from Klaviyo or Mailchimp?

MandrakeCRM integrates CRM, automations, campaigns, and analytics in a single platform. Everything pre-configured. And charges per order, not per contact.

How long does setup take?

5-10 minutes. Install the plugin, paste your token, activate features. Your customers, orders, and products sync automatically.

Do I need technical knowledge to use MandrakeCRM?

No. Automations come pre-configured by experts. Just choose, activate, and go. If you can manage your WooCommerce store, you can use MandrakeCRM.

Will my emails end up in spam?

No. We send from your own domain (marketing@yourstore.com) following deliverability best practices. Your emails reach the inbox.

Which WooCommerce emails are replaced?

9 customer emails: New Account, Order Processing, Completed, On Hold, Refunded, Cancelled, Failed, Customer Note, and Password Reset. Admin emails stay with WooCommerce.

Does it track guest checkout carts?

Yes. Tracks both registered users and guest checkouts for abandoned cart recovery.

Is it compatible with HPOS and Block Checkout?

Yes. Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and modern block-based checkout.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Async processing on cloud servers means zero performance impact on your store.

What if I need help?

Our support team is available via chat and email in English, Portuguese, and Spanish. We typically respond within 24 hours (usually much faster): support@mandrakecrm.com
sections.changelog:
3.21

  • Fix: orders placed through the block checkout recorded no campaign attribution
    at all. woocommerce_checkout_create_order only exists in the classic checkout;
    the Store API builds the order separately and never fires it, so every block
    checkout store was losing 100% of its UTM data — with or without a page cache.
    Attribution is now also saved from
    woocommerce_store_api_checkout_update_order_meta.
  • Attribution is written once per order: if an order already carries UTM data it
    is left untouched, so the classic and block entry points cannot stamp it twice.

3.20

  • Fix: campaign attribution was lost on stores with a full-page cache. UTM
    parameters were only read on the server, and a page cache serves a stored
    copy without ever starting PHP, so a visitor landing on a cached page with
    ?utm_source=… produced no tracking cookie and their order had no
    attribution. Measured on a production store: only 70% of campaign orders
    were attributed.
  • UTM parameters are now also captured in the browser, which runs on every page
    view regardless of the cache. Same cookie, same 30-day window, same order
    meta — no change to stored data or to existing reports.
  • Server-side capture is kept as well, so visitors with JavaScript disabled are
    still tracked and page-cache behavior stays exactly as before.
  • Hardening: values read back from the tracking cookie are now restricted to
    known UTM keys and capped in length.

3.19

  • Removed debug logging that was triggering on every request and saturating
    server logs on customer sites. Improves performance and reduces disk I/O.
  • Security: removed debug entries that were writing customer emails and
    password-reset URLs to PHP error logs.

3.18

  • Marketing opt-in checkbox now inherits the store’s primary brand color
    (resolved from common theme CSS variables: Woodmart, Astra, generic
    –primary-color, --brand-color, --wp--preset--color--primary, and
    WooCommerce default). Border-left accent of the box also matches.
  • Fix: duplicate checkmark overlay in themes that decorate native checkboxes
    with their own ::before/::after SVG. The checkbox is now fully custom-
    rendered with appearance:none plus an inline SVG checkmark, so only one
    check is shown regardless of the theme.

3.17

  • New: Cashback redemption coupons are auto-applied to the cart from a deep-link.
  • When the customer clicks “Aplicar agora” on the redemption widget, the URL
    carries ?apply_coupon=CB-XXXXXXXX. The plugin detects it, calls
    WC()->cart->apply_coupon() and redirects to the cart page so the discount
    shows up immediately — no manual paste needed.
  • Strict whitelist: only codes matching ^CB-[A-Z0-9]{8}$ are applied; any
    other coupon code in the URL is ignored. Idempotent: re-loading the URL
    does not duplicate the coupon.
  • WC native security still enforced (email_restrictions, usage_limit,
    expiration, etc.). The plugin only triggers the apply — WC validates.

3.16

  • Widget script now loads on checkout and cart pages to support Order Bump and other checkout widgets
  • No behavior change for product/home/shop pages — existing widgets continue working as before
  • Each widget in the bundle internally detects its applicable context

3.15

  • Internal release — version bump for plugin maintenance

3.14

  • Internal release — version bump for plugin maintenance

3.13

  • Renaming popup → widget across the entire plugin interface
  • Stability and performance improvements

3.12

  • Added Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages
  • Improved compliance with WordPress.org plugin guidelines
  • Fixed activation check when WooCommerce is not installed

3.11

  • Improved admin interface and user-facing text
  • Complete internationalization (English, Portuguese, Spanish)
  • Documentation updates

2.0.0

  • New plugin architecture with HPOS and Block Checkout compatibility
  • Modern admin UI and improved security
  • Enhanced marketing attribution tracking

1.0.0

  • Initial release
